description: This file defines core data models for a chess game, including classes for squares, pieces, castling rights, and moves, along with JSON serialization helpers.

classes.name: Square
classes.description: Represents a board coordinate with file and rank, including validation and parsing.

classes.name: Piece
classes.description: Represents a chess piece with type and color, including FEN character conversion and JSON serialization.

classes.name: CastlingRights
classes.description: Tracks castling rights for both sides with JSON serialization and copy functionality.

classes.name: ChessMove
classes.description: Models a chess move, including special move flags, UCI notation, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: JsonCodecHelper
classes.description: Provides static methods for JSON encoding and decoding.

methods.name: tryParse
methods.description: Parses a string into a Square object if valid.

methods.name: fromFenChar
methods.description: Creates a Piece from a FEN character.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of CastlingRights with optional modifications.
